description: This PHP class defines a client for interacting with the AWS Route 53 Profiles service, including method signatures for various profile and resource management operations.

classes.name: Route53ProfilesClient
classes.description: A client object to interact with AWS Route 53 Profiles service, extending the base AwsClient.

methods.name: associateProfile
methods.description: Associates a profile with the specified arguments.

methods.name: associateProfileAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously associates a profile with the specified arguments.

methods.name: associateResourceToProfile
methods.description: Links a resource to a profile based on provided arguments.

methods.name: associateResourceToProfileAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously links a resource to a profile.

methods.name: createProfile
methods.description: Creates a new profile with the given parameters.

methods.name: createProfileAsync
methods.description: Creates a new profile asynchronously.

methods.name: deleteProfile
methods.description: Deletes a specified profile.

methods.name: deleteProfileAsync
methods.description: Deletes a profile asynchronously.

methods.name: disassociateProfile
methods.description: Removes the association of a profile.

methods.name: disassociateProfileAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disassociates a profile.

methods.name: disassociateResourceFromProfile
methods.description: Removes a resource from a profile.

methods.name: disassociateResourceFromProfileAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes a resource from a profile.

methods.name: getProfile
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific profile.

methods.name: getProfileAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves profile details.

methods.name: getProfileAssociation
methods.description: Gets association details of a profile.

methods.name: getProfileAssociationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously gets profile association details.

methods.name: getProfileResourceAssociation
methods.description: Gets resource associations for a profile.

methods.name: getProfileResourceAssociationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves profile-resource associations.

methods.name: listProfileAssociations
methods.description: Lists all profile associations.

methods.name: listProfileAssociationsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists profile associations.

methods.name: listProfileResourceAssociations
methods.description: Lists all resource associations for profiles.

methods.name: listProfileResourceAssociationsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists profile resource associations.

methods.name: listProfiles
methods.description: Lists all profiles.

methods.name: listProfilesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists profiles.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: tagResource
methods.description: Adds tags to a resource.

methods.name: tagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously tags a resource.

methods.name: untagResource
methods.description: Removes tags from a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.

methods.name: updateProfileResourceAssociation
methods.description: Updates the association between a profile and a resource.

methods.name: updateProfileResourceAssociationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates profile-resource association.
